snippet.title: Death Howl - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Journey through the sorrowful spirit world. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son. Watch the new Death Howl trailer for this soulslike deckbuilder game to see gameplay and more. Death Howl will be available on PC, and a new demo is available on Steam on June 9, 2025.
